longTitle: How Much Social Security on a $40k, $60k or $100k Salary? (2027 Formula)
sources: Sources: Social Security Administration, Office of the Chief Actuary — PIA formula bend points, national average wage index (2025: $72,800.33), contribution and benefit base ($192,300 in 2027); 2027 COLA Fact Sheet. Calculations: Nest Egg Atlas.

tags: how much social security will i get

clips.title: Social Security at a $40k, $60k or $100k salary (2027 formula) #Shorts
clips.desc: 2027 SSA formula, turning 62 in 2027, 35-year career, full retirement age 67: $40k ≈ $1,844, $60k ≈ $2,377, $100k ≈ $3,400 a month. Education, not financial advice.

clips.title: Fewer than 35 years of work? Your Social Security drops #Shorts
clips.desc: $60k a year: 35 years ≈ $2,377, 30 years ≈ $2,148, 25 years ≈ $1,920 a month (2027 SSA formula, our calculation).
